steps.note: Start the single-stage event creation flow.
Set the event type to RFQ as required by the scenario.
Provide the mandatory event title so the event can be published.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the pricing sheet is created.
Add the CYLINDER product and set its requested quantity to 10.
Complete the remaining pricing-sheet fields required for publication.
Commit a valid event schedule before publishing.
Invite the mapped QA vendors required for the published Participants list.
Verify that publication reached a real project page.
Open the published stage's Participants list, the subject under test.

args.goal: on the buyer's Participants screen, use Filter by city to select a city, verify that only vendors from that city are listed, clear the city filter, and verify that all invited vendors are listed again

steps.note: Perform and verify the city filtering and clearing behavior that no catalog assertion can express directly.
